pages.text: Each bond vibrates at its own frequency and absorbs infrared there: C-H near 2950 cm⁻¹, C=O near 1715, O-H near 3300, C≡N near 2250. A scan must cover the band - and the wider it is, the coarser it reads.
$(thing)Set$(): Scan from, Scan to.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Thermal drift: the band shifts by ±2 cm⁻¹·d.
$(thing)Limits$(): none beyond the recipe windows.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A narrow scan is quick.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Margin: distance of the band from the ends$(br)Scan width: width
